title: Show a missing-description error after Submit
steps: Click Report a Website Issue in the home page footer to display the blank feedback dialog. Turn off optional technical logs before submitting.
Scroll down within the dialog to the screenshot and technical logs controls.
Click Submit with the description blank and inspect the lower form view.
Scroll up within the dialog to inspect the description and its validation message.

video_guide.summary: Submitting the blank website report leaves the lower form in view; scrolling upward reveals the description warning.

chapters.note: The home-page footer includes Report a Website Issue.

chapters.label: Open Report a Website Issue from the footer.

chapters.note: The dialog shows an empty description with a 0/2500 counter.

chapters.label: Leave the description blank, turn off technical logs, and scroll to the screenshot controls.

chapters.note: The screenshot upload area and unchecked technical-log checkbox are visible; the description is outside the visible form area.

chapters.label: Click Submit with the description empty.

chapters.note: The dialog shows the screenshot controls, unchecked technical-log checkbox, Cancel and Submit; no description warning is visible here.

chapters.label: Scroll upward inside the dialog to inspect the description.

chapters.note: The empty description is visible above the red warning: Please add a description before submitting.
The report dialog is open with the same empty description, 0/2500 counter and required-description warning.
